Accommodation in Newry | Castle Accommodation | Killeavy Castle Estate
Discover the finest in luxury accommodation in Northern Ireland at Killeavy Castle Estate. Located just 10 minutes outside Newry and only one hour from Belfast and Dublin airports, Killeavy Castle Estate offers a variety of accommodation options to suit every taste. For those seeking a complete escape from a busy lifestyle, Killeavy Castle Estate is the perfect antidote. Indulge in a romantic couple's getaway, a luxury spa break or simply take a restful rural retreat immersed in the picturesque beauty of nature and historic wonder.
Far from the madding crowds, our range of cosy, luxurious, and comfortable accommodations has something for everyone to enjoy. Killeavy Castle Estate provides a choice of accommodation types, from a 19th-century Castle to a 45-guestroom boutique-style hotel or a collection of one to six-bedroom, self-catering residences. Each option provides a varied experience, upholding the impeccable Killeavy design and standard.
Our Award-Winning Hotel in Northern Ireland
Where old meets new, our modern 4 star hotel was originally a Mill and Coach House. The historic buildings have been lovingly transformed into a family-owned hotel full of charm and elegant comfort.
Clean lines, open space and natural light bring the outdoors inside. Designed to embrace the sweeping views of the estate, each of the 45 guestrooms are sensitively decorated in a soothing contemporary style.
Soft greys boldly contrast highlights of burnt orange, buttercup yellow, winter teal and sage green, echoing the seasonal colours of the surrounding landscape, making Killeavy Castle Estate the perfect destination in Northern Ireland.
Spacious guestrooms are equipped with the latest technology and are suitable for double or twin occupancy. There are ample relaxation spaces, indoor and outdoor, for you to enjoy.
Find out more about our luxury Hotel .
Killeavy Castle Accommodation
Step back in time for that ultra-special family celebration or holiday. Killeavy Castle itself is available for exclusive hire. Inside the Grade A listed building, a full restoration programme has reformed the magnificent castle back to its former glory.
Enjoy the romance of gothic glamour with impressive reception spaces, private Dining Room, the Circular Library and restored architectural features. Fully self-contained with four double guestrooms, lounge and extensive relaxation spaces, each luxury guestroom emulates the original period style. With stone walls, historic paintings, rich fabrics and plush four-poster beds, every angle throws up new silhouettes and delights.
Discover the period charm of our castle accommodation .
Luxurious Self-Catering Residences
For a more modern experience, select from one of four, dog friendly, self-catering residences.
Each residence has been buit to a very high standard of comfort and are within easy walking distance of the hotel, castle and the Slieve Gullion hills beyond. Ideal for small groups, they are a perfect base for family and friends gatherings, cycling, walking or activity holidays in Northern Ireland.
Find out more about our luxury self-catering residences at the foot of Slieve Gullion.
Dining at Killeavy Castle Estate
During your stay at Killeavy Castle Estate, you will be well-catered for. With a Bistro Bar and Gullion Restaurants there is something to suit every taste. Our expertly crafted menus put quality, freshness, and sustainability above all else.
We source our ingredients from our onsite working Estate Farm and Walled Gardens, and handpicked local artisans. You will be spoiled for choice from traditional favourites to our taste-of-the-estate menus.
Northern Ireland's Premier Hotel and Spa
During your stay at our luxury hotel, take advantage of one of our expert spa treatments in our award-winning Elemis Spa. Unwind in our stunning thermal spa area, with a wide range of Elemis facial and massage therapies to choose from.
Our Spa therapists are on hand to give you the perfect stay at Killeavy. Whether you want to unwind after a long day exploring Slieve Gullion or simply relax in our outdoor hot tub, you will find what you are looking for at Killeavy Castle Estate.
Things to do at Killeavy Castle Estate
At Killeavy Castle Estate, you can explore the great outdoors in the Ring of Gullion, an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty. With its mountainous and wooded terrain, the area is a haven for walkers and cyclists alike .
Stroll our estate and take in the sights and sounds of our Walled Garden and onsite Estate Farm. Use the estate as a base while you explore the greenways of Northern Ireland's world-class golf courses .

Luxury Hotel | Killeavy Castle Estate | Northern Ireland
Designed to embrace sweeping estate views, the 45 guestrooms are sensitively decorated in a soothing contemporary style. Soft greys boldly contrast highlights of burnt orange, buttercup yellow, winter teal, or sage green, echoing the seasonal colours of the surrounding landscape. We offer a choice of three-room styles, all spacious, light, and luxurious. Each room contains a super king-size bed, suitable for double or twin occupancy.
The ensuite bathroom has a walk-in rain shower and a separate bathtub for a relaxing soak. Our ample relaxation spaces feature a writing desk and coffee table with soft chairs. Modern amenities and technology include an interactive TV, in-room iron with ironing board, laptop/valuables safe, light refreshments, Nespresso coffee machine, and tea-making facilities.
A single sofa bed can be provided to accommodate a third guest, subject to availability and for an additional charge. Interconnecting and accessible rooms are available upon request.
Click here to view our Hotel Gallery or experience a 3D Showcase of the hotel by viewing the below.
Book Now to view a variety of packages on offer and begin your escape at Killeavy Castle Estate.
Learn more
Our ten Deluxe guestrooms are ideal for those who want added charm and luxury. Deluxe guestrooms incorporate the same offerings as our Superior guestrooms, with the addition of a late check-out to 12 noon and features such as double-aspect windows or enclosed terraces to relax and connect with nature.
All of our Deluxe Guestrooms overlook Killeavy Castle Estate, with farmland and/or Walled Garden views. Step out into the tranquility of the local countryside, or enjoy a nightcap on your private balcony.

Gatelodge | Luxury Self Catering | Killeavy Castle Estate
Our four purpose-built, self-catering, dog friendly residences are located within the grounds of Killeavy Castle Estate and consist of a self-contained, Woodside Studio apartment, one-bedroom Woodside Cottage, three-bedroom Gatelodge and five-bedroom Woodside Residence.
Build your love of nature on the estate's extensive walking trails of Slieve Gullion, or explore the countryside on a mountain bike or e-bike that can be hired onsite. With countless activities on offer around the Ring of Gullion (a designated Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty,) our residences are a perfect gateway to an unforgetable adventure or a tranquil escape.
Access to the hotel's Gullion Restaurant, Bistro Bar and Elemis Spa within the estate means pampering is on your doorstep. As an estate with self-catering accommodation, ample parking, the estate Farm Store (open seven days per week), we offer the best of both worlds to our in-residence guests.
The guestrooms within the residences can only be booked as a whole, not individually.
Learn more
Our purpose-built self-catering Gatelodge is located at the entrance to the estate. Sympathetically designed to embrace the sweeping views, this light and cosy two-storey residence can cater for up to six adults within three guestrooms. Each spacious guestroom contains a king-size bed, with two of the guestrooms being suitable for double or twin occupancy.
A fully fitted kitchen with all modern amenities including laundry facilities, dining area and lounge with a wood burning stove plus a large family bathroom upstairs and a separate shower room downstairs means the Gatelodge is the perfect base for that longer retreat experience.
Access to the hotel's Gullion Restaurant, Bistro Bar and Elemis Spa facilities within the estate means pampering is on your doorstep. As a hotel with self-catering accommodation, we offer the best of both worlds to our Gatelodge guests.
The guestrooms in the Gatelodge can only be booked as a whole, not individually.
All our residences are dog friendly.
Check the availability of our Gatelodge and Book Now for a one-night self-catering Gatelodge break or why not relax for a little bit longer and Book Now for a two-night break.
For those active seekers who want to base themselves in a luxury destination and explore all that Killeavy and the destination of Visit Mourne have to offer Book Now for a three-night stay.

The Woodside Residence at Killeavy Castle Estate is a spacious, purpose-built residence located within the estate's grounds with private parking. It provides a home-from-home experience with plenty of space inside and out and incredible scenic views of the Ring of Gullion.
The residence comprises five double bedrooms (two with en-suite) accommodating up to ten adults, a master bathroom, a lounge with a wood buring stove, dining area and an extensive fully fitted, modern kitchen. The lounge provides direct access into the garden and large terrace with a fireplace.
The Woodside Residence also has the option to be combined with the adjoining self-contained, Woodside Studio apartment, creating a six guestroom self-catering residence. The apartment offers a kitchenette, shower room and spacious, open-plan guestroom with floor to ceiling windows and patio doors leading to an outside terrace.
Whether for a reunion, celebration, or peaceful retreat, the Woodside Residences are the perfect choice for your group gathering. Reserve all three accommodations: the Woodside Residence, Woodside Studio, and Woodside Cottage. Together, they offer seven double guestrooms, accommodating up to fourteen adult guests. Ideal for family and friends coming together, these charming residences provide a picturesque setting to create cherished memories.
All our residences are dog friendly.

The fully renovated, gated Woodside Cottage is the latest edition to the Killeavy Castle Estate Residences. A short stroll from the main hotel with private parking, the Woodside Cottage is nestled at the foot of Slieve Gullion providing direct access to the many walking trails, and is within easy walking distance of Slieve Gullion Forest Park.
The master bedroom comprises a king-size, four-poster bed and en-suite, rain shower bathroom. A bright, yet cosy lounge features the original fireplace and a wood-buring stove. A modern kitchenette and estate Farm Store provides the flexibility for a fully self-catering experience.
